newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CSM to buy U.S. bakery ingredients maker.
newsitem.headline: CSM to buy U.S. bakery ingredients maker.

text.p: Dutch food group CSM NV said on Thursday it had agreed in principle to buy Karp's Inc in the U.S.
Illinois-based Karp's produces bakery ingredients, has annual turnover of $190 million and is profitable, CSM said in a statement.
The takeover sum will be paid in cash, the Dutch firm said without elaborating. It added the takeover is expected to contribute to CSM's net profit in the current financial year 1996/97.
CSM expects its group turnover to rise this year by about 0.6 billion guilders to 3.6 billion. Activities in the U.S. are expected to generate about 1.3 billion guilders this year.
Karp's, which employs 720 people and is mainly active in the east of the U.S., will become an independently working unit.
